title: Off-center Fourier failure bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\\mathcal F$ be a nonempty family of subsets of $[n]$, and let $0<\\varepsilon<1$ satisfy $\\left(1-\\frac{\\varepsilon^2}{6n}\\right)2^n\\le |\\mathcal F|$. Choose uniformly at random a sign-valued function $f$ on the Boolean cube. The probability that there exists a point $x$ of the cube for which the absolute value of the prescribed Fourier off-center sum associated to $\\mathcal F$, $x$, and $f$ is at least $\\varepsilon$ is at most $2^{-n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\\mathcal F$ is a nonempty family of subsets of $[n]$
